name: Defeat All Enemies
_source: s;Mui;I can't express my gratitude enough for you two.
s;Andy;No sweats. Believe it or not, this is a part of our mission as well.
s;Shen;Right, you introduced yourself as a group of Negators.|Tell me, is Master Feng with you?
s;Shen;My senior, Luo, told us that our Master had joined a perculiar group.|Speaking of which, he should be here soon to discuss more.
s;Shen;Luo!{c:wait;400} Why are you looking so down?|Don't tell me you lost in your block after everything you said.
s;Mui;Mr. Andy, Master Shen! Are you two hurt?
s;Andy;He's in <red>Anguish</>. He can no longer tell friends from foes.
s;Shen;I see...{c:wait;800}{c:e;Shen;OpenEyes,Smile} That's perfect! I have always wanted to duel with him!
s;Mui;Master Shen! You can't be joking right now.
s;Shen;No. This guy is a full-blown martial master, so he is my fight!{w} Please, don't get in my way.
s;Andy;Shen, fighting alone is exactly what's got your senior into that state!
s;Fuuko;Mr. Shen! Calm down and think!|What's the actual reason for your obsession with getting stronger?
s;Fuuko;Wrong!{c:wait;400} It's to protect others. That's the truth, isn't it?
s;Andy;Shen, instead of risking your life for a combat high,|focus on protecting what you hold dear.
s;Mui;Master Shen! We are stronger when fighting together.

name: Death Fuuko
_source: s;Fuuko;No... It's not...|{c:e;Fuuko;CloseEyes}I'm sorry, Andy...|Everyone...forgive me...

name: Intro
_source: choice;choice_tutorial;<yellow>Neutralize UMA Tutorial?</>;True|Not yet. I've never played UnEmblem, False|Sure. I've beaten UMA Gunpowder before;;vert;bottom
s;;The world began with only man and earth.;;;Narrator
s;;Then, God added <red>Rules</>, along with the <red>UMAs</> that embodied them:;;;Narrator;no_block;hold
s;;<yellow>{rule}</>;{e:100 + (1 if game.get_random(0, 1) else -1) * game.get_random(24,100)},{e: 56 + (1 if game.get_random(0, 1) else -1) * game.get_random(24,40)};;clear;;;text;no_block;hold

s;;Make no mistake, there isn't a single rule designed to aid men's survival.{w}{clear}{c:m;Tenacity;400}And yet, mankind's hope only grew stronger.|Fighting the UMAs is <yellow>the UNION</>,{c:sound;FireBall}{c:add_region;vision_ragnarok;7,19;1,1;vision;4}|an organisation of <yellow>Negators</> specialized in hunting <yellow>UMAs</>, completing <yellow>Quests</>, and combating <red>God</>.|At the center of the Union lies the <yellow>Roundtable</>, where only their main members can take seats.|And, no matter what,{c:wait;400} only <yellow>the Leader</> can take the first seat.;;;Narrator
s;;"Unluck" Fuuko Izumo.{w} Along with "Undead" Andy, this is the story of their quest against God,{w} for a world freed from unjust rules and hardships.;;;Narrator

s;Juiz;Fuuko,{c:wait;400} you are now this organisation's new boss.{c:e;Fuuko;HalfCloseEyes}{c:wait;100}{c:e;Fuuko;OpenEyes}|The new UNION is in your han-{c:move_portrait;Fuuko;CenterRight;2;no_block}{c:screen_shake;400;celeste;no_block}{c:bop;Juiz;1;no_block}{c:e;Fuuko;CloseEyes}

s;Fuuko;Ms. Juiz...{c:wait;800} I'm afraid I can't reassure you.{c:wait;800} I'm far too weak.|{c:e;Fuuko;HalfCloseEyes}But...{c:wait;800}{c:e;Fuuko;HalfCloseEyes} Mr. Victor told me once before,{c:wait;400} that I was just like you, Ms. Juiz.|That I was willing to bet it all for them.{c:wait;800} That spirit-{c:wait;400}that <blue>Soul</>-That was what I had!|So I-{c:wait;400}I know that much is certainly true.|It's thanks to the UNION that I got to be this way, after all.
s;Juiz;No...{c:wait;400} It's your hard work that moves other people's hearts to help you.|So thank you, Fuuko.
s;Andy;Juiz!{c:wait;400} Those tremors just keep getting bigger.

s;Juiz;Fuuko.{c:wait;400} Our job begins from this point on.{c:wait;800} Please have faith and wait here.|Now that I'm no longer the leader, I can finally fight. I'll be off now...{c:wait;400} boss!|I will risk my life along with the others to ensure that you go through the loop.
s;Fuuko;Ah...{c:wait;400} everyone...{c:wait;400} risking their lives again...

s;Andy;Don't tell me this late in the game, you're blaming yourselves for everyone dying or whatever!|Listen, all we do right now is grab hold of the baton that everyone has passed to us...|So that the two of us can go through the loop, get stronger and come out on top!|Ain't that right?
s;Andy;You got it, chief.{c:wait;400} Catch ya on the flip side, Fuuko!

s;Juiz;Yes. That is <bconvo><red>Sun</></>.{w}{clear}Listen up, UNION!{c:wait;400} This is my last order to you as former boss!|This is Ragnarok-The very end of the world.{c:wait;400} So don't hesitate to risk your lives.|For these last few minutes,{c:wait;400} prioritise blocking God instead of dealing damages to him!|Operation...{c:wait;200} starts now!

name: Countdown
_source: pos = utils.tuple_add(center_pos, tuple(map(lambda x: min(x-1, 2) if x > 0 else max(x+1, -2) if x < 0 else x, v('pos_roundtable')[game.turncount - 2])))

name: Union Reinforcement
_source: s;Mui;Master Shen,{c:wait;400} a-are we all that's left?
s;Shen;My dear Mui,{c:wait;400} I'm afraid we don't have much time either.|Let us not worry about death and ensure Fuuko make it to the next loop!
s;Mui;Even then, I remain hopeful...{c:wait;800} that the seven of us survive,{c:wait;400} just for these last few minutes.

name: Outro
_source: if;all(game.check_alive(unit_nid) for unit_nid in game.level.unit_groups.get('Union').units) and game.check_alive('Juiz_100')
s;Mui;Ms. Fuuko, a gift to the next loop!
s;Fuuko;All of you,{c:wait;400} thank you.|{c:e;Fuuko;OpenEyes}{c:bop;Fuuko;no_block}Now it's time to go!

name: Unit Death
_source: s;Dev;Uhm...{c:wait;400} What?{w} Sorry, I haven't prepared a winning screen.|This will have to do!
s;{unit};Y-you dare killing an UMA?!{c:wait;400} The very embodiment of a Rule?!|You shall suffer the consequence of that r-right now!
s;{unit};Ssstruggle all you want,{c:wait;400} thisss marching of God isss inevitable.
s;{unit};Victor, it's amazing isn't it?{c:wait;400} We pulled together...{c:wait;400}{c:e;{unit};CloseEyes,Smile} some amazing allies.

s;Mui;Oh, Master Shen!{c:wait;400} It's gonna be okay now. {c:wait;400}{c:move_portrait;Mui;120,80} I'm right here...|You know, meals always tasted best when I was with you, Master Shen...|because you looked at me with so much affection.|So please...{c:wait;400} in the next loop, can I be by your side once again?
s;{unit};Yes, of course.{c:wait;400} If you will agree to have me.|And this time I will make you the happiest you've ever been.

s;Shen;Mui...{c:wait;400}{c:e;Shen;HalfCloseEyes} Mui, my dear.|Life before you came...{c:wait;400} was a mindless, murderous world.{c:wait;400} You brought me peace, kindness, and love.| I have been in love you, and will always be until the day I die.

s;{unit};Were my efforts...{c:wait;400} going to help changing fates?|No...{c:wait;400} it wasn't just me. You two were there...{c:wait;400} every step of the way...|{c:e;Rip;CloseEyes}Goodnight...{c:wait;400} Leila...{c:wait;400} Latla...

name: Final Push
_source: s;Andy;Everyone!{c:wait;400} Fuuko!{c:wait;400} This is the final push!{c:wait;400} Hold on just a little longer!

s;Juiz;With bitter regrets of my late comrades.|With my own powerlessness.|With the rage of the torment you caused us these last 455.4 billion undying years.|{c:e;Juiz;OpenEyes}I'll imbue all of those rage in this last attack against you,{c:bop;Juiz;no_block} God!
s;Shen;Let's show them what Shin Hakkyouku is made of together!
s;Shen;Mui, all I did was looking back at the warm memories you had given me.|{c:e;Shen;OpenEyes}But, I'm positive,{c:wait;400} as it's stands, I'm the strongest I've ever been.
s;Mui;Master Shen.{c:wait;400} You have given me both mighty words and power that are mine to use.|I shall live up to the call,{c:wait;400} all through these eyes devoid of lies!

s;Rip;They can be a UMA or God, it doesn't matter.{c:wait;400} I'm going to save everything I hold dear.|If fate decides to take away my happy ending right before my eyes...|then I'd refute and{c:bop;Juiz;no_block} negate that fate!

s;Fuuko;Gods, you may have toyed with us for hundreds of billions of years...|but it seems you still don't know negators.|What gave us strength.{c:wait;400} What pushed us to live.{c:wait;400} What shaped us and held us together...|has always been this feeling that we gain from those we hold dear.|{c:bop;Fuuko;no_block}Do not underestimate us!

name: Tutorial Unluck 2
condition: v('tutorial') and unit.nid == 'Fuuko' and unit2.nid == 'Andy' and unit2.get_skill('Unluck_child')
_source: s;;Now Andy is a <red>ticking time bomb</>! Move Fuuko safely away from him.";;;Tutorial

name: Tutorial Unluck 3
_source: s;;Finally, <yellow>move Andy next to the target</> and end your turn.|A meteorite will soon hit Andy and anyone nearby.;;;Tutorial

name: Death Gunpowder
_source: s;Gunpowder;Ya plumb messed up, partners.{c:wait;400} All these scuffles done is letting me reach ma Phase Two.|Ya puny little attacks ain't got the grit to overcome ma regeneration no more.

name: Intro
_source: s;Shen;Hey, can someone remind me...|{c:e;Shen;CloseEyes}{c:bop;Shen;no_block}What can we possibly be looking for in an abandoned town like this?
s;Andy;Throw in the towel already?{c:wait;400} You are softer than you look, kid.
s;Fuuko;I'm sorry to ask so much of you two right off the gate.{c:wait;400} But the UNION is lacking manpower.|Having your combat prowess is great assurance to our Quest.
s;Mui;You mentioned before that meeting us was your mission as well.|Are your Quests looking for new negators?
s;Andy;Quite close, but no.{w} This time, what we are looking for isn't human, instead...
s;Gunpowder;Hold ya horses right there, partners!;0,24
s;Gunpowder;Ya done crossed the territory of this good ol' me.|Be wise and leave ya gold behind, then I reckon I will let ya ride easy with ya life.
s;Shen;Whoa! A talking yoaguai?{w} I wonder if my punches work on them.
s;Fuuko;It's an UMA, creatures created by God to impose sufferings on human.|And this one is responsible for all those senseless gun shootings recently.
s;Gunpowder;Ah, educated, ain't ya? Well, having brains do ya no good around these parts.|This town is completely run by ma horde of wights, ya see.|Blame ya luck that ya have to cross paths with us.

s;Fuuko;Well, I have never been a lucky person, but it's fortunate that we're able to find you.|You see, our Quest this time calls for the elimination of UMA Gunpowder,|and we have been running close to the deadline.
s;Gunpowder;Ya...Ya must be the UNION!{w} Apocalypse put a hit on me? That dratted book!|That's sealed it. Ain't none of y'all shall leave here alive.

name: House
_source: s;Dev;Robber? There's a robber in my house! Help!
s;{unit};Weirdo.{w} Ooh, free gauntlets on the table.

s;Dev;Hi, I'm the game dev.|Everytime you visit a house like this, there is supposed to be a cutscene.|But I'm lazy to write a cutscene.|So if you have an idea or want to insert yourself into this game as a cameo,|hit me up on Discord.|Please visit this house again for the sample custscene, and free item.

name: No Unluck
condition: unit.nid == 'Fuuko' and item.nid == 'Unluck' and not v('phase_two')

name: Intro
_source: s;Announcer;Welcome back, folks!{c:wait;400} It's the moment you've been waiting for!|Let's get Tenraisai,{c:wait;400} the annual tournament to decide the strongest martial artist,{c:wait;400} underway!;4,24
s;Announcer;I-it's a knockout!{c:wait;400} Another full point for Shen Xiang of the Shin Hakkyoku school!;4,24
s;Shen;Haaa...{c:wait;400} The participants this year sure are disappointing.
s;Luo;Perfect form, solid strike. Well done, Mui,{c:wait;200} you've grown strong.
s;Shen;Luo? What are you doing here?
s;Luo;And Shen, you lack caution and discipline!|Strength is not the only thing that matters in martial arts.
s;Shen;Master gonna disagree with you on that.
s;Luo;...{c:wait;400}{c:e;Luo;CloseEyes}My apology. I don't mean to lecture you.|{c:e;Shen;NoSmile}{c:e;Luo;OpenEyes}I came here to bring news about Master Feng.
s;Mui;Has he returned for the tournament?
s;Luo;No, his whereabout is still unknown.|However, I have learnt that he has joined a perculiar group.
s;Announcer;-and with that, we will now move on to the open stage!|Participants, please head back to your assigned block and get ready!;4,24
s;Luo;...{c:wait;200}We will discuss more after this.|Exercise caution, you two, if you want to win in your block.
s;Shen;...{c:wait;400}{c:bop;Shen;no_block}Come clean, Mui! You're using another new <violet>Artifact</>, aren't you?
s;Mui;No, y-you see, this just arrived a moment ago...
s;Shen;It's like I keep telling you,{c:wait;400} using too many artifacts will corrupt your spirit!
s;Mui;But, sir...{c:wait;400} I am ill-equipped without negator abilities of my own.|At the very least, I wish to pay you back for participating in this tournament for me.

s;Shen;Nope. You got it all wrong.{c:wait;400} I joined Tenraisai this year solely to grow stronger,|to become the strongest in all creation.{c:e;Shen;OpenEyes} That's the truth.|Getting the prize, the medicine for your brother, will be a lucky coincidence.
s;Mui;B-but Master Shen, as Master Luo said, we have to be cautious.|There are many more participants this year than ever.
s;Shen;Yea, yea,{c:wait;400} I'm being cautious alright.|{c:e;Shen;OpenEyes,Smile}{c:bop;Shen;no_block}Cautiously holding back my punches, that is!

s;;Mui was right to be concerned, as the number of enemies you are allowed to defeat is limited!|You see, each player unit has a <blue>Composure</> gauge that decreases when they defeat an enemy.|Do not let that gauge reaches 0, or that unit will fall into <red>Anguish</>.;;;Tutorial

name: Composure Depleted
condition: unit2 and unit2.team == 'player' and unit2.get_mana() == 1 and v('cp_depleted_count') < 2
_source: s;{unit2};I'm at my limit as well.{w} {c:e;{unit2};OpenEyes}{e:'Master Shen, we' if unit2.nid == 'Mui' else 'We'} need to regroup.
s;Mui;There are even more of them now...
s;Shen;I know your strength isn't lacking.|But your composure,{c:wait;400} your spirit won't hold out after defeating them all.
s;Shen;Then it is but a training session for me.|Remember?{c:e;Shen;Smile} I joined this tournament to become the strongest there is.|So this is perfect for me.
s;Andy;But that ain't the truth, is it?
s;Fuuko;Mr. Shen! Mui!{c:wait;400} Are you two okay?
s;Mui;W-who are you?{c:wait;400} And how do you know our names?
s;Fuuko;We are UNION, an ally to all <violet>Negators</>.{c:wait;400} Let us help!

s;Shen;Okay. No.{c:wait;400} UNION? Never heard of you.|So we've only just met, you really think we can trust you right away?|Besides, I alone can win this tournament.{c:wait;400} They will be my fuel to grow even stronger.
s;Mui;But Master Shen,{c:wait;400} your spirit is at its limit right now.
s;Andy;Shen, you do understand right?{c:wait;400} The truth behind strength.|Individual strength is not all there is.
s;Fuuko;Please, you can count on us.
s;Shen;...{c:wait;400}{c:e;Shen;CloseEyes}{c:bop;Shen;no_block}Urgh! Fine! Do as you please!|{c:e;Shen;OpenEyes}But leave their strongest one to me.
s;Fuuko;We'll buy you some time. Please regain your composure with these.
s;{unit2};...{c:wait;400}{c:e;{unit2};CloseEyes}This is too much.{w} Sorry, I can't stomach knocking out another person today.

name: Tutorial Weapon Triangle
_source: s;Fuuko;Mui, is it okay for Shen to lead the charge like that?|He only has an Iron Spear on him.
s;Mui;Miss Fuuko, are you worried about how enemies are all Gauntlet-wielders?|It's fine, because Master Shen's <violet>negation</> allows him to reverse the Weapon Triangle.
s;Fuuko;Ah, so that's his interpretation of Untruth this loop.

s;;I should teach you about Weapon Triangle first: Physical weapons possess a unique hierachy.|<red>Swords</><icon>Swords</> best <green>Gauntlets</><icon>Brutes</>.|<green>Gauntlets</><icon>Brutes</> best <blue>Spears</><icon>Spears</>.|<blue>Spears</><icon>Spears</> best <red>Swords</><icon>Swords</>.|This is called the Weapon Triangle.|Using the correct weapons against the enemy will grant damage and accuracy boost.|Using the wrong weapons, however, then your damage and accuracy will suffer.|<orange>Guns</><icon>Firearms</> are not affected by the Weapon Triangle.;;;Tutorial

name: Shen Fights Luo
_source: s;Shen;Luo...{c:wait;800}{c:e;Shen;CloseEyes} The truth is...{c:wait;400} all I'm focusing on right now is protecting others.|{c:e;Shen;HalfCloseEyes}But I'm positive,{c:wait;400} as it stands,{c:wait;400}{c:e;Shen;OpenEyes}{c:bop;Shen;no_block} that I'm the strongest I've ever been.

name: Outro
_source: s;Mui;You went out cold after knocking Master Luo out of his frenzy state.|Thanks to you, I've safely gotten the Elixir and gave it to my brother.|{c:e;Mui;Smile}He's made a full recovery.
s;Shen;Oh, good.{c:wait;400} So that was worth it then.|And where are our UNION pals?{c:wait;400} I have some questions to ask them.
s;Andy;I'm convinced, you have complete control over your negation, Untruth.|Feng was involved in it, wasn't he?

s;Shen;...Yes, it's been a decade since Untruth manifested.{c:wait;200} Master Feng left on that day.|I've practiced my negation to become the edge that help me defeat him,|that is if he hasn't become senile already.
s;Mui;Ms. Fuuko,{c:wait;400} you said that UNION is an ally to all Negators.|I can tell that both you and Mr. Andy are Negators as well.|Then are you here to recruit Master Shen?
s;Fuuko;Not just him.{c:wait;400} We are here for both of you.|Mui, our friendship goes a long way back after all.
s;Mui;I-I don't get it. But I'd love to have a chance to help you back.
s;Andy;Then all that's left is your answer, Shen.

s;Shen;I don't know when, but I had forgotten it.{c:wait;400} That fight has helped jog my memory.|I get stronger for other people's sake. I get stronger for them, and they for me.|For my sister, for my master,{c:wait;400}{c:mirror;Shen} and for you, Mui.|I'm sure that this feeling...{c:wait;400} this emotion...{c:wait;400}{c:e;Shen;Smile}{c:bop;Shen;no_block} This is the truth behind becoming the strongest.|Let's get stronger, together this time.
s;Fuuko;We are glad to have you two!
s;Shen;And by the way, Mr. Andy, was it?|{c:e;Shen;HalfCloseEyes,Smile}I remember a myth about an immortal fighter with the same name.|I sure would love to square off against you one day.
s;Luo;Thanks for stopping me, Shen.|I'm ashamed that you have to witness me in that frenzy state.
s;Shen;Zip it. All I'm interested in is his whereabout.
s;Luo;Right, straight to business...|The truth is, Master Feng has joined a group of individuals with special ability.|Their name?

name: Tutorial Unluck 1
_source: s;Mui;It's no use.{c:wait;400} The UMA is regenerating faster than the damages we dealt.
s;Shen;At this point, the only way for us to defeat it is with a single strong hit.
s;Fuuko;...Thank you, you two.|Andy and I can take it from here. Go check on Isshin for me, please.
s;;Andy and Fuuko is preparing for an <purple>Unluck</> special move.|To do so, first <yellow>move Fuuko next to Andy</> and <yellow>use Unluck</> on him.;;;Tutorial

name: Isshin Intro
_source: s;Shen;A bone face! So you are with those skeletons, huh?
s;Fuuko;Wait, Mr. Shen, they're an ally!{w} This is Isshin, our weaponsmith.|They have been traveling with us...{c:wait;200} well...{c:wait;200} since the start.
s;Shen;Then how come I didn't notice such a big guy this entire time?
s;Fuuko;They said they were shy of strangers.

s;;Isshin is a <blue>Convoyer</>. Player units can access <blue>Item Storage</> when standing next to Isshin.|When convoyer's HP reaches 0, they'll return next chapter, instead of leaving permanently.|However, convoyers cannot move nor fight, so do remember to protect them from harms.;;;Tutorial

name: Tutorial House
_source: s;;Hey! Over there!{c:wait;200} That door is open!;;;Tutorial
s;;<blue>Houses</> like that always give a free item to visitors.{c:wait;200} You should send a unit to <yellow>visit</> it.;;;Tutorial

name: Fight Gunpowder
_source: s;Gunpowder;Smell that?{w} The smell of gunpowder is the smell of justice in the West!

name: Outro
_source: s;Fuuko;Sorry about that. It was brought here by my Unluck.|My negation causes misfortune on anyone I touched.
s;Andy;My throat feels parched.{c:wait;200} Other than that, not really.
s;Shen;Unbelievable. He took a direct meteorite hit and walked out unscathed.
s;Fuuko;Mr. Nico, we've just finished neutralising UMA Gunpowder.
s;Nico;Yea, I notice the discrepancy already.|Gunpowders no longer exist, and firearms are now powered by wielders' strength.;4,28
s;Mui;...Hasn't it always been like that?

s;Nico;Ms. Mui, was it?{c:wait;200} Do take note.|When an UMA is added or killed, reality is rewritten.{c:wait;200} Negators are unaffected,|but non-Negators like us are brainwashed into thinking of it as common knowledge.{w}{clear}...Scientists dedicated their lives uncovering physics, and God changes it on a whim!;4,28
s;Nico;You lousy God!{c:wait;400} I'm gonna use science to tighten the noose around your neck-;4,28
s;Fuuko;Sorry about that.{c:wait;400} That's Mr. Nico, the head engineer in the UNION.|He always gets so heated when it comes to slaying God, but he's very capable.
s;Shen;Slaying God, though.{c:wait;400} Talk about a tall dream.
s;Andy;Let's wrap it up here, guys.{c:wait;200} 'Bout time we head back to the base.
s;Mui;A-are we even allowed to enter there?
s;Fuuko;Of course!{c:wait;200} You two are official members of the UNION already.
s;Andy;We are together in this God-slaying mission from now on, after all.
s;Mui;Please wait!{c:wait;200} You can't just drop this news on us now!

name: Demo End
_source: s;Dev;Hii, game dev here.{c:wait;400} Sorry but this is where the demo ends.|I hope you enjoyed this short demo, and feel free to walk around in this UNION HQ.
